limitations: Retirement fixtures exercise real owner methods with explicit runtime fixtures; they do not themselves qualify signed native START, worker completion, training or a Terminal-Bench score.
The broader run contains all 23 retirement cases; adding its 69 passes to the 23 passes would double-count those cases.
Two status-index expectations fail with both the changed and original gateway module. This reproduces the baseline failure in that module substitution scope, not an entire clean historical checkout.
Command files and XML are bounded redacted projections. Original command, exit, XML, stdout and stderr digests are retained for provenance. Exit metadata is copied byte-for-byte.
No original gateway source, callback bodies, model files, credentials, hostname, absolute checkout path or private temporary-directory data is included.
